known_gaps: No focused automated coverage was found for permission-helper precedence, inactive assignment exclusion, product-context aggregation, or dashboard projection.
The final built-in manager initializer omits users.metadata.manage, creating a migration-history-dependent default bundle that is not regression-tested.
The platform permission catalog declares products.manage, product_origins.manage, and platform_users.manage without an inspected built-in platform-admin grant.
The is_protected flag is not generally enforced by the product-role handler; only manager-key protection is verified in code.
